jobs.title: Spiralyze: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, Georgia
URL: https://www.spiralyze.com/

The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.

Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplines—research, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.
 

Key Responsibilities

You’ll own three core responsibilities:
  1.  Coordination. You’ll manage cross-functional teams of 5–10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea → build → launch → analysis. You’ll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  2.  Strategy & Planning. You’ll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10–20 upcoming experiments. You’ll communicate the “why” behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.
  3.  Energy (“Vibes”). You’re the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Here’s what we need from you:
 
  1.  Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and don’t stop until things are finished properly.
  2.  Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.
  3.  Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or don’t. You’re the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

What You’ll Get

  • Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles.
  • Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? We’ll help.
  • In-demand skills. You’ll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.
  • Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.
 
If you’re excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, we’d love to hear from you.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/spiralyze-project-manager-1

jobs.title: Expel: Product Manager, Detection Pipeline
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

You live at the intersection of security and product management, and there's no place you'd rather be. You understand that the detection pipeline isn't just plumbing. It's the connective tissue that turns raw security data into signal, and if ingestion, normalization, or correlation break down, everything downstream suffers. You're not intimidated by the scale and complexity of data flowing through a modern security platform. Quite the opposite: you pride yourself on knowing how data moves from source to detection, where the pipeline breaks, and what it takes to make it fast, reliable, and cost effective.

You’ve got an informed opinion about what an MDR should detect, an opinion that comes from customer empathy, hands-on industry knowledge, and a set of experiences that didn’t always go as planned. You can hold a technical conversation with a SOC analyst and turn around and explain the same thing to a Sales team in plain English. You've been waiting for a role where that combination of skills actually matters.

Still reading? Great. This role isn't for all PMs. Yes, all the standard PM things apply: plan, prioritize, communicate, and own a roadmap, build relationships, and become the authority on how internal teams and customers use your platform. But in this role, you'll bring your security experience to bear on one of the most foundational parts of Expel's platform. If you get your energy from untangling how security data flows through a platform at scale and turning that into a roadmap that makes customers safer, you'll thrive here.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you clear ownership of a product area with measurable impact on customer value and business outcomes.
  • Surround you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and operators who are genuinely invested in building something great.
  • Offer a foundation to build on: the detection pipeline is critical to Expel's platform, and there's meaningful work ahead.

What you can do for Expel

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Expel's detection pipeline (normalization, correlation, and automated detections and suppressions), from defining the six month vision to driving execution with Engineering and UX.
  • Establish relationships with internal teams (SOC, Detection Engineering, Engineering) and customers, and use their input, alongside market and competitive signals, to build and prioritize a roadmap that maximizes impact.
  • Be the voice of your roadmap: clearly articulating value to Detection Engineering, SOC, Sales, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing to effectively communicate the value of the detection pipeline internally and externally.

What you should bring with you

  • A curious, customer-obsessed mindset — you're comfortable asking "why" until you get to the real problem.
  • 2–4 years of experience in product management or a directly relevant role, with experience in the security industry strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with product management and software engineering processes, from requirements definition through to launch.
  • Familiarity with security tools — EDR, SIEM, and firewall products — and how they fit into a customer's security stack.
  • Broad knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and where security risks emerge in those environments.
  • Experience with SIEM technologies is highly desired — bonus points if you've navigated integration or data pipeline challenges firsthand.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — you can write a crisp user story and present to a customer in the same afternoon.
  • The ability to build trust across Engineering, Security Operations, Sales, Customer Success, and UX.

Additional notes

This role is remote within the United States.

The base salary range for this role is between $114,300 USD and $165,700 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $125,000 and $145,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

Contra Labs sits at the intersection of human creativity and AI. We partner with leading AI labs and product companies to improve their tools across design, video, development, and beyond. Our research is grounded in how top creatives actually work, studying the patterns behind what gets created, what gets chosen, and what resonates. jobs.title: Baymard Institute: Market Research Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Denmark
URL: https://baymard.com/

We’re seeking a full-time, remote Market Research Data Analyst for our company.

Baymard Institute conducts large-scale UX research studies, sharing our findings through a bespoke B2B SaaS platform that serves 2,000+ retailer stores, brands, and agencies across 80+ countries — including 71% of Fortune 500 e-commerce companies. We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX.

 

What You’ll Do

As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication.

Our Quant Insights team conducts recurring studies examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area.

This means the role combines variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology. You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process.

At the same time, the process itself is not fixed.

Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve. Team members are encouraged to challenge existing approaches, experiment with better methods, improve our tooling and workflows, and propose changes to how studies are designed or executed.

If you identify a better way to design a questionnaire, analyze our data, automate part of the workflow, structure a study, or even rethink part of our research process, we want you to make the case for it and help us improve it.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

Research & Survey Design

  • Conducting desk research to understand an industry, its consumers, and the ecommerce experiences we want to investigate.

  • Translating research objectives into clear, testable research questions.

  • Designing questionnaires, including question wording, response scales, survey structure, branching, and screening criteria.

  • Identifying appropriate respondent audiences, quotas, and sample requirements.

  • Reviewing pilot results and refining questionnaires before full fielding.

  • Considering potential sources of survey bias, measurement error, and data-quality issues throughout the research process.

 

Survey & Fieldwork Execution

  • Programming and QA’ing surveys (we use Alchemer), including logic, quotas, branching, and redirects.

  • Coordinating with sample providers on feasibility, targeting, and setup (we use PureSpectrum).

  • Monitoring soft launches and active fieldwork.

  • Evaluating incoming responses for data-quality issues and determining appropriate cleaning or exclusion criteria.

  • Troubleshooting issues independently.

 

Data Analysis & Synthesis

  • Cleaning, structuring, and analyzing survey datasets.

  • Conducting descriptive and comparative analyses across questions and respondent segments.

  • Exploring relationships and meaningful differences within the data while avoiding overinterpretation of results.

  • Identifying the most meaningful findings from large survey datasets rather than simply reporting every result.

  • Synthesizing findings across multiple questions to develop broader insights into consumer behavior.

  • Creating charts and writing analysis takeaways that communicate findings clearly.

  • Translating quantitative findings into concise, evidence-based insights relevant to ecommerce UX professionals and decision-makers.

Your role may gradually expand to include new or more complex studies, program management, or strategic initiatives, depending on your interests and Baymard’s needs.

 

Your Daily Tasks

While your exact workload will vary depending on where your current study is in its lifecycle, most of your time will involve activities such as:

  • Researching consumer behavior within an industry.

  • Designing and refining survey questions.

  • Programming and QA’ing surveys.

  • Reviewing pilot data and determining what should change before launch.

  • Coordinating sampling and monitoring fieldwork.

  • Cleaning and preparing survey datasets.

  • Analyzing overall results and meaningful respondent segments.

  • Investigating interesting or unexpected patterns in the data.

  • Determining which findings are meaningful enough to publish.

  • Creating charts and synthesizing findings into clearly written research insights.

The remainder of your time may involve team discussions, methodology development, documentation, process improvements, tooling, cross-functional collaboration, or experimentation with new approaches.

 

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys both the design and analytical sides of quantitative research.

  • Likes taking ownership of a research project from an initial question through final findings.

  • Enjoys working with structured processes and becoming better and more efficient at executing them over time, while offering ideas and initiative to improve and streamline them as needed.

  • Is naturally detail-oriented and methodical in their work.

  • Is comfortable troubleshooting and resolving field issues independently, but knows when to escalate larger problems for discussion or review

  • Communicates clearly and asks precise questions when clarifying requirements.

  • Enjoys cross-functional work and being involved in the early stages of a program.

 

What You’ll Need

We’re looking for the following qualifications for this role:

  • 2–3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, market research, survey research, consumer insights, or a closely related field.

  • Hands-on experience designing questionnaires and conducting online survey research.

  • Experience analyzing survey datasets and synthesizing quantitative findings into meaningful conclusions.

  • A solid understanding of survey design fundamentals, including question wording, response scales, questionnaire structure, screening, and common sources of bias.

  • Experience working with survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or similar.

  • Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, statistical software, or other analytical tools to explore and analyze quantitative data.

  • Comfort interpreting percentages, distributions, cross-tabulations, and differences between respondent groups.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing, to audiences who may not have a research background.

  • Strong communication skills and a disciplined, detail-oriented working style.

You’ll be part of our growing Quant Insights team and will work closely with the Research, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Operations teams, making collaboration essential.

 

Practical Details

  • Location: This is a remote, full-time position from the UK, Ireland, or the EU. Baymard is a registered employer in the UK, IE, and DK.

  • Language: We expect you to be fully proficient in written English. Written English is critical to this role, and you will have to submit your application/cover letter in English.

  • Salary: Based on qualifications and country average.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Travel: Is limited; expect only 1-2 weeks of travel each year (often only in connection with the company-wide meetup).

  • Company: Learn more about Baymard’s work culture and values here. Also, consider reading this article about our Quantitative Insights work.

 

How to Apply

If you’re interested in this position, please apply by sending all of the following documents:

  1. A cover letter written in English (PDF format; 1-2 pages) describing how you fit the role and qualifications. (Required.)

  2. A CV/resume (PDF format) or a link to your LinkedIn profile. (Required.)

Send the above to quant2026@baymard.com.
(All applications and materials are treated confidentially.)

Deadline is November 15th, 2026 (end of day).

 

Sincerely,
Richard Lam, Quant Insights Lead at Baymard Institute

 

Referral Bonus: If this job isn’t you, but you know someone who’ll be the perfect fit, please send them the link to this page. If we end up hiring the person you referred, we’ll give you 12 months of access to a Baymard Expansion plan (normally $4,200/year).

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/baymard-institute-market-research-data-analyst

jobs.title: Prove: Senior Software Engineer, Identity Platform
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

About Prove 

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.   

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! 

Title: Senior Software Engineer

Department: Engineering

Reports To: Manager, Engineering

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: US Remote

 

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer at Prove, you will play a critical role in building, maintaining, and scaling the technology that powers the next generation of identity verification. Whether working on consumer and business identity services or developing low-level phone intelligence data signals, you will design and implement robust, high-performance solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges, improve system architecture, and contribute to the mission-critical infrastructure that helps institutions solve fraud and verify digital identity worldwide.

Team Focus Areas

We are currently hiring for two engineering teams, each solving unique challenges in the identity space:

  • Data Engineering Team: Join our team to design and build the fault-tolerant, scalable platforms powering our core identity services (Verified Users, Prefill, and KYB/KYC). You’ll work hands-on with senior engineers and product leaders to tackle complex, high-scale architectural challenges and directly influence our identity verification roadmap.
  • Phone Number Intelligence: Our team focuses on phone intelligence and generating low-level data signals used by various internal services. This work is foundational to our fraud detection capabilities, providing specialized knowledge of mobile carrier data and fraud patterns. We are currently migrating data and migrating to an event-driven architecture, offering an exciting opportunity for someone to shape our infrastructure.

 

Responsibilities

  • Engineering Excellence: Write high-quality, maintainable code, develop detailed technical documentation, and champion strong engineering principles within the team.
  • System Development: Design and develop microservices within a cloud-native, distributed architecture.
  • Problem Solving: Analyze, debug, and resolve production issues. Proactively engage in technical design discussions, including writing and reviewing RFCs for new solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor team members, participate in code reviews, and drive technical decisions. Own end-to-end features—from initial design and RFC creation to implementation and maintenance.
  • Collaborative development: Participate in the "Owner/Helper" project model; contribute as a lead owner for major milestones and actively support team members on their own initiatives.

 

Your First Three Months

30 Days (Onboarding): Gain a high-level understanding of our architecture, team goals, and existing services. Make your first code contributions by resolving bugs or tackling small tasks within the codebase.

60 Days (Contribution): Integrate into the design process by reviewing RFCs and providing technical feedback. Contribute significantly as an active team member to one of our milestones.

90 Days (Ownership): Develop a deep grasp of our product and migration strategies. Take ownership of a minor or major milestone, or lead the drafting of an RFC for a new initiative.

Qualifications

  • Software Development: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a deep understanding of object-oriented programming (Java highly preferred).
  • System Design: Experience designing event-driven, robust, and scalable solutions for complex technical problems.
  • Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Data & Database Expertise: Proficiency in SQL (Oracle) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) with strong knowledge of design principles for both.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Full-Stack Development: Experience with TypeScript and React.
  • CI/CD & Testing: Ability to build automated test frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Streaming Technologies: Practical experience with Kafka and Flink.
  • Modern Tech: Familiarity with AI and machine learning integrations.
  • Technical Leadership: Proven ability to influence team direction and long-term architectural decisions.

 

This position description should not be considered the final description of the position. The position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the positions. It should be assumed that we would, to some extent, structure responsibilities in accordance with the successful candidate’s capabilities and changing business conditions. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

The anticipated salary range for this role is 

Metro 2: 190,000 - 210,000

Metro 3: 170,000 - 190,000

Plus variable commission / company bonus. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.



Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines:

  • Metro 2 - NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area.
  • Metro 3 - all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area.
Benefits & Perks for FTE Provers:
  • Competitive salaries & Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan
  • Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan & Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices)
  • Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours
  • Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ️
  • Emotional & Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP & Prove Well-Being Reimbursement)
  • Bottomless snacks & beverages for certain office locations
  • Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices)
  • A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself!

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Prove we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Equal Opportunity Employment:

Prove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics 

Privacy & Data Protection:

When you are applying for a job at Prove, we collect and use your personal information in the job application process. To understand more about how Prove uses your personal information, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy on our website.

jobs.title: Oportun: Principal Product Manager, Savings (R13997)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity 

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Oportun’s flagship, AI-powered Savings product. Savings is an important driver of member growth and retention, giving this role significant influence over the future of our financial health platform and how we help members build stronger financial futures.

You’ll lead the ideation, development, launch, and scaling of new products and features while partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support. This role reports to the Vice President & General Manager for Savings and Mobile. Candidates located in Central or Eastern time zones are strongly preferred to support team and stakeholder collaboration.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll lead the long-term product strategy and roadmap for Oportun’s Savings product in partnership with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • You’ll scope and lead the development of new products and features designed to improve members’ financial health and strengthen growth and retention.
  • You’ll use customer research, experimentation, data, and product metrics to build a deep understanding of member needs and behaviors and translate those insights into product decisions.
  • You’ll lead a high-performing cross-functional product team across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Support to bring new capabilities to market.
  • You’ll drive alignment across teams and leadership through clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and strong product judgment.
  • You’ll navigate complex legal and regulatory considerations while keeping the team focused on member outcomes and execution.
  • You’ll bring ideas for how we can do things better, proactively, not just when asked.
  • You’ll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully to accelerate product discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and create stronger member experiences.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a curious and creative product leader who enjoys solving ambiguous problems and turning customer needs into clear product strategies. You combine strong product judgment with data, move comfortably between strategy and execution, and build trust across a wide range of partners.

You’re customer-focused, solution-oriented, and comfortable navigating complexity without waiting for perfect information. You communicate clearly, build alignment, and keep teams moving toward meaningful outcomes.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including experience building and scaling products in high-growth environments.
  • A strong track record of defining product strategy, building roadmaps, and shipping products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Strong customer orientation and a passion for building products that improve financial health.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with experimentation, product metrics, data analysis, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional product teams and building alignment across Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Legal, Customer Support, and senior leadership.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex product decisions clearly and concisely.
  • Experience navigating ambiguity, removing blockers, and driving execution across complex product initiatives.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, digital banking, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience launching products within complex legal or regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience using SQL or similar tools to support product analysis and decision-making.
  • Experience working with globally distributed or multinational teams.
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar tools to improve product discovery, analysis, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you 

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. 

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: 

US Benefits: 

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) including company match
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave
  • Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers

Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Elation Health: Case Resolution Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada - Remote

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them.

You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility.

As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Synthesize and share customer insights. Surface patterns from your cases in weekly and monthly reports, participate in Product and Engineering discussions with what you're learning, and mentor Support Team members on AI workflows, scripting, and SQL queries.
  • Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.
  • Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations and scripts, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Delivered solutions that reduced case volume by 10% or eliminated recurring issue categories, with measurable customer impact (e.g., CSAT, reduction in case reopens)
  • A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume
  • Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster
  • You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it
  • You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Support can run with
  • You've picked up or sharpened a technical skill — SQL, Python, an API, a scripting language — specifically because a customer problem needed it, not because a course assigned it
  • Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis
  • Identified and closed gaps across internal and customer-facing documentation, improving accuracy and reducing repeat questions.

Professional Qualifications

  • 1–5+ years of experience in Engineering, data analytics, or AI/automation tinkering in any field — OR a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, plus real experience talking to people under pressure (support, hospitality, retail, service, resident advising)
  • Comfortable enough with code to experiment : you've written scripts, touched an API, or built something in Python, SQL, or JavaScript — even if it was just for a class project , team project or yourself
  • A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations, class or personal projects — with evidence of outcomes
  • Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills
  • Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle
  • AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them
  • A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own
  • Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts
  • An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

  1. 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — a work project, a personal build, or something from school or an internship — what you made, who it was for, why you needed to do it, and what changed.
  2. A short story about a time your analysis or insight changed a decision someone else made.

Salary range

$70,000 - $95,000 CAD

 

Elation welcomes individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life. Elation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is dedicated to creating and maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment.

We are committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, and value individuals with diverse perspectives including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Elation also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. We firmly believe a strong culture that supports a diverse and inclusive workforce allows us to achieve Elation’s mission of helping independent primary care thrive.

jobs.description:

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. As a Sr. Manager, Corporate Sales you’ll …

  • Provide hands-on support by joining client meetings, leading key conversations, and coordinating internal resources to remove obstacles.

  • Demonstrated success in hiring, onboarding, and developing high-performing sales talent

You’ll thrive as a Sr. Manager, Corporate Sales if you:

  • Have strong coaching and mentoring skills, with a passion for developing early-career sales professionals
  • Communicate clearly and confidently in both internal and external settings
  • Understand the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing
  • Are proficient in CRM systems (such as Salesforce), forecasting tools, and sales analytics
  • Know how to analyze team performance metrics and turn insights into actionable strategies
  • Can navigate complex deals and align multiple stakeholders to drive outcomes
  • Lead with empathy and collaboration, building trust and empowering your team to succeed
  • Bring strong business acumen and a strategic, data-driven mindset to decision-making
  • Take ownership and demonstrate accountability while maintaining a bias for action
  • Foster a positive, inclusive team culture centered on learning, growth, and shared success
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States (Remote)

About Prove 

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.   

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! 

Title: Senior Director, Global Customer Support

Department: Support / Operations (iO)

Reports To: Chief Customer Officer

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: US Remote

 

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Global Customer Support is a key executive leader responsible for defining and executing Prove’s worldwide support vision, strategy, and operational framework. Reporting to executive leadership, this role oversees a dual-shore support delivery model - leading high-performing US-based technical support and escalation teams while governing offshore support operations and BPO/vendor partners across global regions.

This leader will drive continuous evolution across Prove's global support ecosystem to ensure world-class customer experience, SLA performance, and scalable support architectures that support rapid enterprise growth, while optimizing the scope, capacity, and productivity of each support tier. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Revenue, and Customer Success, the Senior Director will champion the voice of the customer, transform support through AI and self-service automation, and foster a culture of technical excellence across all geographic hubs.

 

Key Responsibilities

Global Leadership & Dual-Shore Operations (US & Offshore)

  • Global Team Architecture: Build, scale, and lead a high-performing global support organization consisting of US-based engineers and offshore multi-tier support teams.
  • Offshore & Vendor Governance: Direct offshore vendor partnerships, BPO relationships, and captive international teams, ensuring seamless follow-the-sun coverage, strict quality assurance, and aligned culture.
  • Talent Development & Culture: Inspire, mentor, and build career pathways for support managers, leads, and engineers across US and international hubs.

Strategic Vision & Operational Excellence

  • Support Strategy & Scalability: Define and execute the global technical support strategy, aligning organizational goals with enterprise customer growth and retention. Assess team capabilities and optimize skills and experience to reduce burden on internal teams.
  • SLA & KPI Performance: Establish, monitor, and optimize global performance frameworks (CSAT, SLA attainment, Aging, MTTR, First Contact Resolution, Escalation Rates).
  • Process Standardization: Design and enforce standardized standard operating procedures (SOPs) across domestic and offshore teams to maintain consistent high-quality service delivery globally.
  • Executive reporting: Real time dashboards and consistent reporting to ET on the health of customer support, bottlenecks and top issues raised by customers.

Digital Transformation, Systems & AI Automation

  • Modernization & Systems Leadership: Drive technology priorities and infrastructure investments across ticketing, CRM, telephony, and knowledge management systems.
  • Self-Service & AI Integration: Implement AI-driven workflows, generative AI tools, and proactive self-service capabilities to deflect transactional inquiries and empower support teams.
  • Data & Analytics Insights: Deliver executive-level operational dashboards and qualitative/quantitative insights to quantify support business impact and identify root-cause trends.

Executive Escalation & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Enterprise Escalation Management: Define and implement an escalation management process to ensure effective resolution and clear communication internally and externally,   for critical platform incidents and high-value enterprise customer issues.
  • Design and implement internal escalation flows to the different internal teams owning ticket resolution, with clear visibility into bottlenecks and aging issues.
  • Voice of Customer (VOC) Feedback Loop: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Revenue leadership to systematically channel support insights into product roadmap improvements and defect remediation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to optimize retention, expansion, and customer onboarding experiences.

 

Qualifications and Experience

  • Industry Experience: 12–15+ years of progressive leadership experience in enterprise technical support, customer operations, or customer success within global SaaS, fintech, identity, or complex cloud API environments.
  • Leadership Track Record: 5+ years of experience leading multi-tier global support organizations at the Director or Senior Director level.
  • Dual-Shore & Offshore Management: Proven success managing distributed teams across the US as well as offshore delivery centers or third-party outsourcing (BPO) partners.
  • Technical Agility: Strong technical depth in enterprise SaaS software, API integrations, cloud environments, and contact center technology ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Jira, PagerDuty, AI platform tooling).
  • Analytical & Operational Expertise: Demonstrated ability to build, analyze, and optimize core support KPIs, root-cause models, and cost-per-ticket metrics.
  • Executive Communication: Exceptional verbal and written presentation skills with experience delivering operational reviews to C-suite stakeholders and enterprise clients.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience (Master’s or MBA preferred).

 

Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

 

Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines:

  • Metro 2 - NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area.
  • Metro 3 - all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area.

  • Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan & Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices)

As a Data Engineer focused on AI/ML, you’ll build, maintain, and optimize the data infrastructure that powers Tebra’s intelligent features. You’ll partner closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to transform complex healthcare data into high-quality datasets and real-time features that enable machine learning models.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll contribute to scalable data pipelines, improve data quality, and help ensure our AI systems are powered by reliable, performant, and well-governed data. You’ll work on modern data platforms and gain experience building solutions that support both model training and production inference.

jobs.title: Mercury: Business Risk Officer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. We work hard to create the easiest and safest banking* experience possible to simplify our customer’s financial lives whether they are entrepreneurs, business owners, or individuals.  Mercury has also obtained a provisional national bank charter and is currently taking proactive steps for final approval. 

Role Overview:

We're looking for a Business Risk Officer to help scale the way Mercury builds products.  In this role you will report to our Head of Business Risk & Enablement and will partner with Product, Operations, Compliance and many other support and oversight teams to ensure that products and features are delivered “best-in-class” in a safe and sound manner.  Your success in this role will rely on subject matter expertise in one or more of Mercury’s core product offerings and associated risks. You will also be primarily responsible for the facilitation of non-financial risk management programs (see below).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify any potential blind spots in processes and controls, and suggest commercial improvements/enhancements
  • Facilitate pre-launch and new activity initiatives/reviews, tracking items to closure and escalating where/when necessary
  • Facilitate execution of risk self assessments and similar exercises within the non-financial risk frameworks
  • Event/incident, issues , and remediations management - ensuring that incidents and issues are recorded and managed through to remediation in line with any and all relevant frameworks in the company
  • Develop and enhance iteratively KPIs/KRIs to be monitored by yourself, product/process owners, and other stakeholders in order to mitigate risk
  • Coordinate interactions and responses between Product and Operations teams vs. other stakeholders for audits, exams and similar reviews (internal and external)
  • Engage and partner deeply with stakeholders across the organization including Product, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, etc.
  • Help design / provide feedback on certain enterprise/firm-wide trainings and deliver trainings as needed

Qualifications:

  • Have at least 5 - 7+ years of experience in a banking, fintech, or other financial services firms in a product/business, business risks and/or controls, operational risk, or other similar roles
  • Track record of balancing risk, compliance, and customer experience in cross-functional settings
  • Excellent communication skills to simplify complex business, reg and/or risk concepts into clear explanations and/or recommendations
  • Familiarity with Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) practices and non-financial risk frameworks
  • Curious, growth-oriented, and motivated to work on risk and controls at all lifecycle stages (new product launches, scaling, and legacy optimization)
  • Bring a collaborative, problem-solving mindset to your work, have strong stakeholder management skills, and an ability to influence without direct authority
  • Approach your work with a high quality bar and a strong sense of ownership - you see things through to completion, knowing when to be pragmatic vs. when not to settle
  • Proficient with AI tools, or eager to get there, to drive efficiency in risk and controls work — a growth mindset is enough if you're not an expert day one.

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote US

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Reports to: SDR Manager

Location: Remote US

Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. jobs.title: Semaphore: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Novi Sad
URL: https://semaphore.io/

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.


We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.


About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.


AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.


This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

  • Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.
  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.
  • Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.
  • Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.
  • Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

  • A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.
  • Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.
  • Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.
  • Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.
  • Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.
  • Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
    Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.
  • Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.


We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.


Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.
  • Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

  • You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.
  • Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.
  • You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.
  • You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable.
  • Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through.
  • The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result.

How you will work

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment.


You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships.

jobs.title: Wrike: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Czech Republic - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. As the leading collaborative work management platform, Wrike generates an enormous amount of rich, interconnected data, including work item content, relationships between entities, complex business processes, user interactions, and direct user input. The mission of the DS/ML department is to transform this data into intelligent, AI-powered capabilities that help users gain deeper insights, automate routine work, enhance productivity, and create a more seamless work experience.

As a Data Scientist in the Work Intelligence Unit, you will play a key role in product development through the application of state-of-the-art AI and machine learning technologies with a particular focus on leveraging Large Language Models and other emerging technologies. You will work on both user-facing AI features and foundational intelligence platform that power intelligent experiences across the product. 

Your Impact:

  • Creating new and improving existing AI solutions Involvement in the whole process of data-driven development from analyzing product requirements to launching the feature or system to production (with the help of MLOps specialists) and improving it based on results of monitoring and feedback
  • Communicating with fellow data scientists, product owners, and developers
  • Applying best software engineering practices to build a reliable codebase
  • Performing code reviews
  • Working in agile environment and presenting the results of your work on regular sprint reviews

Your Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in AI,  Data Science, and Machine learning 
  • Experience in LLMs, LLM-based APIs, prompting techniques, metric-driven development of prompt-based features, agentic systems, and other related topics
  • Experience in building complex multipart and multistep LLM-based and ML systems
  • Proficiency in Python (including pure Python, and not only jupyter notebooks)
  • Experience in using reproducible research techniques
  • Experience in developing AI solutions for production usage
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Standout Qualities:

  • Experience in AI and ML solutions related to one of the areas: social networks, recommendation systems, ranking, entity matching, process mining, system personalization, risk estimation
  • Confident statistical and machine learning skills 
  • Experience in creating core AI systems that are foundational to the product and are used in many parts of it
  • Experience in classical software development and architecture

Interpersonal skills:

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills required with the ability to work within all levels of an organization.
  • You are proactively pushing yourself to develop your skills and knowledge
  • Decision making and argumentation skills
  • Open to feedback and ready to react on it
  • Ability to work autonomously on a project level

Our Work Style:

  • Code: Python, Jupyter, mypy, uv, black, flake8
  • Data: pandas, SQL, BigQuery
  • GenAI & LLMs: Langchain, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Vertex AI, Braintrust
  • LLM Platform: Versioned Prompt Registry(jinja2), Declarative LLM Feature Configs (multi-step workflows, model routing)
  • ML: scikit-learn, lightgbm, pytorch
  • Cloud: GCP, Dagster, MLFlow
  • Coding Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor

Team Dynamics:

As part of Wrike’s AI center of excellence — you will help scale AI feature development across teams by collaborating closely with product, engineering, design, research, and other departments across the organization. You will explore new AI-driven opportunities, validate hypotheses through experimentation, and drive innovations from research prototypes to production-ready capabilities that deliver tangible value to millions of users.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 5 Weeks of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation 
    • 5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days
    • 2 weeks fully paid w/ medical certificate, additional 
    • 4 weeks paid at 80% salary rate
  • Parental Leave (fully paid): 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Meal Vouchers (CZK 220 per working day)
  • Annual Prague Travel Card (Lítačka)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • Benefit budget with flexible options, including a MultiSport card, Canadian Medical membership, contributions to a pension savings plan and additional choices available through Benefit Plus

  • Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  • Technical interview
  • Cultural interview

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

jobs.title: Webflow: Senior Developer Educator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid); U.S. Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Developer Educator to help us create best-in-class video, written, and hands-on education content for Webflow customers, and those who want to define the next phases of the web. You’ll present on camera as a developer educator, and,  to keep your skills fresh, you’ll build production grade sites using Webflow that we use in our education videos and courses. You’ll also keep your skills fresh by learning how to integrate Webflow with other services and technologies and then develop content demonstrating how.

About the role:

  • Location: San Francisco HQ or Remote (United States)
    • Travel required to SF - 1 week per month
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.

    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $129,000 - $155,000
      • Zone B: $121,500 - $146,000
      • Zone C: $113,000 - $136,000

This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals. 

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position

  • Reporting to the Director, Education Video

 As a Senior Developer Educator you’ll … 

  • Build the reference websites that anchor Webflow University courses, tutorials, and live training — real, production-quality sites and components that hold up to scrutiny from developers and designers, not just demos that survive a screen recording (see examples in our videos at Webflow University)
  • Shape technical curriculum in partnership with instructional designers and video producers, scoping what each lesson needs to demonstrate and why, before anything gets built or shot
  • Present technical content on camera for tutorials, course lessons, and live sessions — walking through code and craft with the clarity of someone who actually built the thing
  • Work alongside video producers and instructional designers through pre-production, shooting, and review, so what's on screen empowers learners to do the thing
  • Serve as the education team's technical subject matter expert, reviewing content for accuracy and pressure-testing it against how people really work and build
  • Keep the technical library current as the platform ships, deciding what's gone stale, what needs rebuilding, and what's newly worth teaching
  • Partner with product and engineering to understand what's coming, so education is ready when it launches rather than catching up after

About you:

Requirements:

  • 4+  years of experience in technical education and web development and/or design
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to write, review, and explain code - leveraging AI tools to accelerate development and refine quality.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching technical concepts to a mixed audience through video, documentation, courses, workshops, or community work
  • Willingness and ability to present on camera - from an outline or word-for-word script, in studio or from your own home setup

You’ll thrive as a Senior Technical Educator if you:

  • Build things because you need to understand them, not just to ship them
  • Can address multiple audiences — the visual developer who's never opened a code editor, the engineer evaluating how Webflow can help them build better, and the marketer who’s been handed off components and templates to build with
  • Take feedback on your on-camera work as craft input rather than personal critique
  • Enjoy collaborating with technical and less technical education teammates alike, recognizing the unique role each person plays in the success of a project
  • Are passionate about learning, education, and helping others succeed
  • Are equally confident showing the messy middle of a build or the polished result
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor. 

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.
