jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

jobs.location: New York, New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wingâs fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Regional Flight Operations Support Manager to join our Flight Operations team. This role is based remotely in the United States.

Represent Wing by engaging with public and government visitors to support regional outreach activities.

What Youâll Need:

    • Physical Requirements: Ability to perform moderate physical work and maintain attention in outdoor environments for extended periods, including the ability to lift and transport equipment

jobs.title: Data Entry Administrator
jobs.description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business.

Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done.

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it.

Tasks

We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems.

You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response.

What You’ll Own

  • Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs.
  • Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text.
  • Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost.
  • Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred.
  • Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns.
  • Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software.
  • Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture.
  • Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python.
  • You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline.
  • You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations.
  • You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred.
  • You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate.
  • You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success.
  • You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents.
  • You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software.
  • You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence.
  • You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding.

Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

You May Not Be a Great Fit If

  • Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface.
  • Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, or experimentation, and you do not want to own production software and operational behavior.
  • You treat retrieval as the complete agent architecture rather than one possible source of context within a larger execution system.
  • You consider a coherent model response successful without verifying the decision, tool call, state change, or real-world outcome.
  • You rely on an agent framework to provide the system design and are not comfortable reasoning about the control flow, state, permissions, and failure behavior underneath it.
  • You are not interested in owning evaluations, trace analysis, regression testing, and production learning alongside feature development.
  • You prefer fully scoped implementation tasks with stable requirements and limited responsibility for product or operational outcomes.

Benefits

Real ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's codebase, you're building a core, novel part of the product from the ground up.

  • Build at the core. Own a defining part of xHeron’s technology, from the first architectural decisions to production.
  • Shape the direction. Work directly with our CTO, challenge assumptions and help decide what we build, not just how.
  • Grow beyond the job description. We invest in your development, with room to expand your ownership and take on technical leadership as xHeron grows.
  • Share in the upside. Salary plus VSOP participation, so you can benefit from the value you help create.

Our Process

  • Intro call (15-30 min): a conversation with Friedrich (CTO) about your background, what you've built, and why this role.
  • Technical take-home case study: a short, real engineering problem, close to what you'd actually be building.
  • Case study interview (1 hour): you walk us through your thinking, not just the final code.
  • Culture fit (30 min): meet both Founders and make sure it's a fit both ways.

jobs.description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen.

Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte.

What You'll Do

Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen. Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden.

Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung.

Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe.

Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen.

Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch.

Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit.

Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo.

Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.

What Makes You a Fit

Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung.

Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes.

DATEV-Erfahrung. Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.
Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen.

Digitale Sicherheit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung.

Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus.

Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Sprachkenntnisse. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau.

KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann.

Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

jobs.title: Founder's Associate (Praktikum)
jobs.description:
TL;DR — alago bringt KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement in die Baubranche. Als Founder's Associate (Praktikum) arbeitest du direkt mit den Foundern, hältst den operativen Maschinenraum am Laufen — Hiring, Ops, Datenschutz, Produkt- und AI-Setup — und übernimmst daneben eigene Projekte, die unser Wachstum beschleunigen. Vollzeit-Praktikum, vor Ort in München, Start Oktober 2026.

Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut.

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren. Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3)

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

  • Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

  • Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

  • Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

  • AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3)

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

  • Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

  • Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

  • Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

  • Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate, Vollzeit

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

Wie du arbeitest

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht.

  • AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup.

  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier)

  • Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung: Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Was du danach kannst

  1. Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt.

  2. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient.

  3. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden.

  4. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr.

Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen

Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran: Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst.

Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen

  1. Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln.

  2. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago.

Wie du dabei wächst

  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm.

  • Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch.

  • Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

  • Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung.

  • Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup

  • First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/

Zusätzlich bieten wir:

  • Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community.

  • Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung.

Closing

1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung

Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast.

2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Janick oder Ann-Christin, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen.

3. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort)

Besuche uns in München und arbeite mit uns an einer realistischen Aufgabe – z. B. einen Hiring-Funnel strukturieren, ein Produkt-Setup vorbereiten oder eine interne Automatisierung entwerfen. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst.

4. Entscheidung

Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

💡 Bewirb dich direkt hier über „Jetzt bewerben“ mit deinem Lebenslauf und deiner Story.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Advisory - Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Manager - Accounting Advisory
Senior Managers at CFGI will work closely with ‘C-level’ management of FTSE 100, mid-cap, and start-up companies. CFGI Senior Managers lead project teams and interact with clients and their Big 4 auditors on all aspects of engagements, including report writing, developing and managing client relationships, and business development.
 
Take ownership of your career at CFGI:
·       Gain exposure to a wide range of industries and/or projects.
·       Make a true business impact with your clients.
·       Own projects from start to finish.
·       Experience client interaction and thrive in a client-facing role.
·       Be consistently challenged and learn through a collegial environment created from top tier experts hired within the firm.
·       Enjoy the flexibility of office/remote/client site work locations (engagement specific).
·       Create your own path.
·       Enjoy what you do!
 
What you might expect:
·       Interact with clients’ executive team and auditors, serving as a subject matter expert, leading clients through complex accounting issues and driving conclusions.
·       Lead client engagement and own client delivery on operational due diligence for complex transactions (i.e. – IPO’s, acquisitions and divestitures, stock offerings, and debt raises).
·       Drive client deliverables of financial and regulatory information in accordance with regulatory requirements.
·       Serve as a subject expert matter on projects related to new accounting standards.
·       Lead process improvement projects and implementation of changes.
·       Mentor managers and consultants, acting as a moral and ethical role model, fostering engagement team professional growth, and providing constructive and actionable feedback.
·       Lead firm initiatives and identify areas for improvements.
·       Play an active role in the firm’s recruiting efforts, client relationship building, and business development efforts.
 
Who you are:
·       An undergraduate degree in Accounting – ACA, ACCA, CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience will be considered in lieu of a degree in accounting.
·       Eight plus years of experience in public accounting and/or industry accounting and /or finance.
·       Outstanding interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills with an ability to assimilate easily into teams.
·       Strong technical skills and a working knowledge of IFRS, UK GAAP and US GAAP.
·       Proactive in identifying client needs and effective in building a strong relationship with clients.
·       Highly organized and focused and demonstrates the ability to set overall engagement expectations and direction.
·       Effective analytical and critical thinking abilities.
·       Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable.
·       Commitment to quality client service, focusing on ensuring positive resolutions to conflicts.
·       Consistently seek opportunities to enhance your skills by attending higher-level training, developing firm training materials, and enhancing the overall firm knowledge base.

jobs.title: Medior / Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer within Axon Product Development to help us build new functionality and add improvements to our SaaS platform. If you have an eye for writing code and are interested in agile methodologies, we’d like to meet you!

Key About Your Role

As a Software Engineer within a Scrum team, you use high-quality code to solve complex puzzles. You collaborate with business analysts and test engineers to create new functionality for our customers and add internal improvements to our software. Together with the other members of your Scrum team, you take full responsibility for a vital part of the software.

You strive to deliver solid solutions by optimising their performance, usability, testability and maintainability and are proud of the products that you create. You analyse complex problems by actively cooperating with colleagues from various teams and find the best solution by combining different insights.

We also embrace AI-assisted software engineering as part of our development lifecycle. Our engineers use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Codex to support activities across the SDLC. From exploring requirements and solution options, to writing and refactoring code, creating tests, debugging, documentation and code review. AI is a development aid, not a substitute for engineering judgement: you are expected to understand the solutions you deliver, validate AI-generated output and remain accountable for its correctness, security, performance and maintainability.

As part of a large community of fellow software engineers, you are always looking for opportunities to improve your engineering skills, experiment with better ways of working and continuously improve our software and code base.

Key About Your Team

The Axon Product Development department consists of more than 120 colleagues, organised across 9 functional clusters (like Claims, Contracts, Financials, Request) and 16 Scrum teams. Together, they extend Axon’s functionality and continuously improve the product, ensuring it evolves in line with the changing needs of insurance companies and continues to deliver lasting value to our customers and their policyholders. 

Check out our blog posts and videos to see what it is like to work at Keylane. 

About Keylane Property & Casualty

As the leading European supplier of robust, highly configurable and customer-centric SaaS platforms to the insurance industry, Keylane offers solutions that optimise today’s business processes, unburdens our clients and empowers them to be future-fit and agile.

With Axon, we aim to foster trust and empower lasting partnerships by providing an all-in-one SaaS platform that ensures a 24/7 uptime for our customers. We provide and implement continuous upgrades at no additional costs, guaranteeing that our customers are able to comply with the latest rules and regulations. Coupled with our commitment to backwards compatibility, we are a partner our clients can rely on with a platform that always delivers.

Requirements

  • You are passionate about software engineering. You love to put your strong analytical skills to the test whilst working closely together with your team.
  • You have experience with large technical ecosystems using Java, IntelliJ, Git, Gradle, Angular and Docker;
  • You have experience working with SQL and databases (DB2, PostgreSQL);
  • You are used to creating and performing unit, system and integration tests as part of your development work;
  • You understand the Agile way of working, tools and techniques;
  • You have an eye for writing code with attention to performance, scalability, maintainability and testability;

Using AI

  • You have used AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in your work or your own projects. You can explain how you have used them to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, develop or improve code and tests, troubleshoot issues, or support code reviews.
  • You understand how AI-assisted development fits into the broader software development lifecycle. You can guide coding assistants with clear requirements and context, including through reusable instructions, skills or agents where relevant.
  • You critically review, test and debug AI-generated code. You can identify incorrect assumptions, security vulnerabilities and maintainability issues, and you remain accountable for the logic, architecture, quality and security of what you deliver.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and integrating AI-assisted development into those workflows is a plus.

*A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and reference check are part of the application process. 

*Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply

Benefits

  • Starting with a monthly gross salary for a candidate between €3,500 and € 5,200 (medior) and between €4,300 and € 6,200 (senior) based on 40 hours per week;
  • 8% holiday allowance of your total gross salary;
  • A profit share;              
  • A pension scheme, with the option to save extra;
  • Travel reimbursement: Receive a mileage allowance of €0.23 per km or an NS Business Card, which can also be used for personal travel;
  • 24 holiday days (with the option to buy extra) and 7 inclusion days, which can be exchanged with fixed Dutch national holidays, allowing you to take them when you like;
  • Flexibility in working environment. As part of a hybrid working team, you will work partly from home and partly from the office. If you work in the office, a free lunch is waiting for you every day. If you work from home, you will receive a working from home allowance (€ 4 net per day) and internet allowance (€ 35 net per month);
  • The possibility of working remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year;
  • The possibility to lease a bike through our bike leasing program;
  • A one-year contract that, subject to satisfactory performance, will be converted into a permanent contract;
  • The opportunity to develop yourself at our Academy through courses and training, both professionally and personally;
  • A comprehensive vitality offer to help you stay healthy. Read more here;
  • An active and fun community of ‘Keylaners’. We also have after work drinks at our in-house pub every Thursday.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive - New Business
jobs.description:
About Smartnumbers

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. 
 
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. 
 
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. Together, we protect some of the UKs largest banks, insurance companies and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people into high performing teams.


What you'll be working on

We're looking for someone to build out a long term 2–3 year strategic pipeline. As part of the role, you will be expected to do the following: 
 

  • Build and maintain a 12–18 month active pipeline to support business objectives
  • Build and maintain relevant market awareness through client discussions, market research and industry events
  • Provide senior management with clear updates, progress and forecasts as evidenced through the company CRM
  • Nurture the customer advocacy program in support of our broader business goals
  • Prioritise activities to meet quarterly business targets while maintaining a longer-term strategic pipeline

What you’ll achieve 

You’ll be helping us achieve our mission by enabling fraud investigators across organisations to collaborate in their fight against fraud using our SaaS platform. The types of areas you’ll look at include: 
  • New Business Development
  • Leading client facing discover conversations to establish key business issues
  • Understanding and navigating the different approaches to fraud prevention across different sectors
  • Helping Clients build business cases for Smartnumbers adoption
  • Sharing intelligence and best practice across organisations
  • Increasing market awareness by supporting events, posts or other GTM activities
  • Building trust and a network of advocates among your client base

How you’ll work 

You’ll be part of an empowered cross functional go to market team that leverages best practice and seeks continual improvement. You’ll be given the freedom to manage your own time with support and guidance from senior sales leadership. You’ll be expected to build, maintain and report on a clear 12–18 month runway of pipeline with dedicated time set aside each week for strategic focus and execution on new business development.


What you'll need for the role

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience: 
 

  • Numbers Obsessed – You live and breathe your pipeline and progress and take pride in its resilience and accuracy.
  • Curious - You want to understand the problems our customers face and how we might solve them. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc.
  • Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business
  • Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it
  • A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO


What we can offer you

As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:  

  • Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
  • Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
  • An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members 
  • A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown 
  • Life insurance of 4 x your salary 
  • Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests
  • 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year
  • A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year.


The application process

We have a simple 3 stage application process: 

  1. 30-minute phone call with the hiring manager
  2. 1 hour interview and presentation
  3. HR and Bar Raiser Interview

We welcome all applications for this role.  
 
We are committed to providing reasonable support/adjustments in our recruiting processes. If you need support, please reach out to the hiring contact.

At ALVA Energie, we’re driving the energy transition forward! With solar operator models for apartment buildings and commercial properties, we offer a comprehensive, worry-free package: from installation and management to the operation of PV systems as an energy supplier. We think: impact over headcount! At our company, FP&A doesn't grow with the volume of work, but with its impact on the business. Data preparation, variance commentary and standard reports belong to automation and agents. Our people's time belongs to what machines can't do: judgment, model logic, challenge and decisions. If an additional hire enables significantly more impact, we grow. But never to absorb manual work that is better built than distributed.

You are the first dedicated hire in FP&A, start as an Individual Contributor and work directly with the CFO and management. Our existing models and tools have grown organically and are partly manual. You understand them, keep what works, rebuild the rest and automate consistently. With AI agents, you build the leverage that elsewhere would take an entire team.

Outlook: The path to Head of FP&A is open, but not planned for the short term. Your responsibility grows with the impact you create, not with team size.

Your responsibilities

As the Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d), you will drive financial planning, analysis, and artificial intelligence initiatives to support our growing operations.

  • Rebuild the FP&A foundation: current-state assessment, target architecture, budget, rolling forecast and multi-year planning

  • Build and maintain integrated, driver-based financial models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for projects, the portfolio and the group, including multi-entity planning and intercompany

  • Develop the KPI framework and prepare management, board, investor and bank reporting with clear recommendations for action

  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses and conduct deep dives on investments, financing, pricing and portfolio prioritization

  • Build and operate agentic AI workflows for forecasting, anomaly detection, variance commentary and reporting, incl. guardrails and governance

  • Close collaboration with the Data Team: you bring the finance logic and are the most demanding user of the data

  • Evaluate and implement suitable FP&A tools and manage tool and AI costs (FinOps)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling or strategic finance, ideally in a high-growth, complex environment

  • Experience in rebuilding or redesigning planning and reporting processes, as well as with planning and BI tools

  • Strong communication skills: you convince management, investors, banks and business functions

Ideally you bring:

  • Energy sector experience, ideally solar/renewables, or other project-based business models

  • Multi-entity planning, intercompany and investor/bank reporting

  • Good German language skills

  • Experience with Claude or other AI coding tools and agentic workflows

In addition, we value the following skills:

  • Tech affinity: You see new tools and AI as leverage, not as a threat

  • Openness to change: You approach change positively and with agility

  • Impact mindset: For every analysis, you ask which decision it enables, and for every task: "Does a human need to do this, and where does it create the greatest impact?"

  • Entrepreneurial thinking: You always consider financial decisions in the context of growth, market opportunities and overall strategy

  • Drive to shape: You look at an organically grown Excel model and know what to keep, what to rebuild and what an agent can take over

  • You are motivated by the mission to advance the energy transition

Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Marketplace professional with deep Amazon Vendor and Seller expertise, a strong drive for results and a passion for building great teams and client partnerships.

As a Senior Marketplace Manager, you will own the strategy and commercial performance of some of our most important brands on Amazon, while leading and developing a team of Marketplace Managers. You will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and day-to-day execution, and help our clients grow beyond Amazon into the wider marketplace landscape.

What You'll Be Doing

Client & Commercial Leadership

· You will be the senior point of contact for a portfolio of high-value brands across Amazon Vendor (1P) and Seller (3P), building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and executive sponsors.

· You will own commercial performance across your accounts – sales, profitability and advertising efficiency – proactively identifying risks and opportunities and reporting on anything that may impact performance.

· You will lead Business Reviews (QBRs) with clients, coordinating the wider team to deliver best-in-class, insight-led presentations and recommendations, in person at regular points throughout the year.

· You will identify new opportunities within key accounts and consultatively sell expanded scope – new marketplaces, territories and services – aligned with client and internal goals.

Amazon Strategy & Performance

· You will develop and deliver annual and quarterly growth plans across 1P and 3P, including channel strategy decisions such as hybrid models, catalogue rationalisation and 1P/3P transitions.

· You will lead on Vendor commercial levers – supporting annual negotiations, forecast and PO health, shortages and chargebacks, and ASIN-level profitability.

· You will oversee Seller Central performance – pricing architecture, Buy Box, FBA inventory health and account health.

· You will set the direction for Amazon Ads strategy across Sponsored Products, Brands, Display and DSP, ensuring media investment is measured against total sales and profitability, not ad metrics alone.

· You will ensure retail readiness across accounts – content, A+, Brand Stores, ratings and reviews, and catalogue hygiene.

· You will work with eCommerce Operations & Marketing teams to deliver promotional calendars, tentpole events (Prime Day, Black Friday) and new product launches.

· You will use our proprietary technology, Channel Optimizer and Compass, alongside Amazon and third-party tools, to turn complex data into clear, actionable insight.

People Leadership

· You will line manage and develop a team of Marketplace Managers and Executives – setting objectives, coaching, running 1:1s and performance reviews.

· You will set the standard for team output, quality-assuring reports, recommendations and client communication before they reach the client.

· You will drive best practice, process improvements and cross-learning between Marketplace and eCommerce Acceleration teams.

· You will balance the needs of multiple clients against internal priorities, delegating effectively and managing client expectations.

Multi-Marketplace Growth & Business Contribution

· You will support brands expanding beyond Amazon UK – into pan-EU Amazon marketplaces and other channels such as Zalando, eBay, TikTok Shop and bol.

· You will provide insightful input to your manager and the Senior Leadership Team to aid strategic decision making, and act as an internal subject matter expert on Amazon.

  • You will have deep, practical knowledge of both Amazon Vendor Central and Seller Central, with a proven track record of scaling brands across both models.

  • You will have a strong understanding of Amazon Advertising and how media, retail readiness and commercials combine to drive profitable growth.

  • You will have proven people management experience – developing, motivating and holding a team to a high standard.

  • You will have strong commercial acumen – comfortable with margin, profitability and setting and owning commercial targets.

  • You will have a strong analytical skill set, with advanced Excel and experience of tools such as Helium 10, Keepa or PowerBI.

  • You will have seasoned presentation skills, with the confidence to manage senior stakeholder expectations and deliver difficult messages backed by data.

  • You will have the ability to operate at a strategic level, yet remain close enough to the details to troubleshoot issues and be a real support to your team.

  • You have strong attention to detail and the ability to manage and prioritise multiple client requirements.

  • Business proficiency in English is essential.

You will be the person the business turns to when a regulator opens an inspection, and when a sensitive cross-functional situation needs to be stabilised quickly and handled with judgement.   • Serve as the primary point of coordination between the business and the regulator.

  • Protect the company's position throughout — controlling disclosures to what is necessary and appropriate, safeguarding confidential supervisory information, and ensuring the executive team and boards are informed at the right moments.

  • Lead the response to the exceptional, time-critical situations that carry material regulatory, financial or reputation risk and need to be handled at pace.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany
jobs.description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

At Oviva, we’re on a mission to make sustainable, personalized, clinically effective care accessible to everyone as we build Europe’s leading AI-powered chronic care platform. Our digital programmes help people manage weight-related illnesses by focusing on what matters most: improving health, building confidence, and enhancing quality of life.

To date, we have supported over one million people across the UK, Switzerland, and Germany. Our mission is powered by a dedicated team operating across four countries, including our hub in Poland. Every conversation, coaching session, and line of code brings us closer to a healthier future.

Our journey is accelerating: In 2026, we secured €200 million in Series D funding led by Kinnevik and a group of leading global investors. This investment fuels our next phase of growth, allowing us to scale our AI-enabled chronic care platform across Europe and expand our support to even more people living with chronic conditions.

Join us, and be part of the team making that future possible!

The role

The Senior Growth Marketing Manager (a) designs, tests, and expands rapid marketing growth initiatives across Europe to accelerate patient acquisition for our digital health applications (such as our obesity and hypertension programs in Germany). Acting as an entrepreneurial growth hacker, this individual identifies novel acquisition channels, maximizes existing platform performance, and elevates land-to-lead conversion rates (in close collaboration with our dedicated product & engineering squad). This position directly advances our mission of making personalised, clinical care accessible to everyone by building a robust, repeatable pipeline of new patient leads.

In this role, you will enjoy a high degree of autonomy, balancing strategic planning with a hands-on approach to executing initiatives. You will act as a subject matter expert within the Marketing team, fostering a culture of high performance and evidence-based decision-making.

You will find and involve the right experts and agencies for new channels and initiatives to ensure we learn best practices as a key part of our expansion strategy.

Requirements:

Essential

  • Growth Hacking & Rapid Experimentation Mastery: A proven track record of managing data-driven marketing initiatives and scaling paid digital acquisition channels from inception to maturity. This includes executing rapid experimentation frameworks across new channels,and driving conversion rate optimization where it makes sense.

  • Commercial Acumen & Financial Modeling: Strong capability to build data-driven financial business cases that translate long-term commercial goals into clear, actionable roadmaps. Demonstrated experience balancing aggressive customer acquisition scale with strict Cost Per Lead targets to continuously improve core business metrics based on analytical insights.

  • Advanced Analytics & Growth Architecture: Exhibit a deeply analytical mindset with the technical expertise to design growth automation workflows, manage complex data visualisation tools, and leverage AI tools to maximise cross-functional efficiency

  • Agile Problem-Solving & Resourcefulness: Exceptional agility to navigate highly ambiguous, fast-moving environments and drive immediate execution ("today rather than next week"). Proven ability to identify and collaborate with external expert networks or specialized agencies to integrate state-of-the-art testing practices, combined with the resourcefulness to independently source freelance talent or AI tools when internal team capacity is stretched.

  • Minimum Viable Product Testing & Lifecycle Handover: Ability to launch nimble, unpolished baseline experiments to validate initial growth hypotheses without demanding perfect workflows upfront. Possesses the strategic capability to transition successful pilots into structured future-state processes, followed by sourcing, onboarding, and training internal talent to fully own the mature channel long-term.

Desirable

  • Experience navigating performance marketing regulations within the healthcare or German digital health application sector.

  • An established professional network of digital marketing experts, freelancers, and agile agencies.

Education & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, statistics, (business) informatics, or a related field

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in performance marketing or growth hacking, preferably in a B2C startup environment

  • Language Qualifications: German C1+ and fluency in English

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and Validate Growth Opportunities: Discover and map new acquisition channels (e.g., partnerships, influencer marketing, programmatic), aggressively expand existing channels, and execute conversion rate optimization strategies through deep personalization of landing pages and lead surveys (where needed). This role stays up to date on new trends in existing channels & potential new channels by monitoring ad platform changes, competitors and the overall market.

  • Construct Robust Business Cases: Build high-level commercial business cases for every new testing initiative, establishing clear parameters for target scale and acceptable Cost Per Lead boundaries that successfully transition channels from experimentation to maturity.

  • Own and Establish State-of-the-Art Testing Protocols: Architect world-class testing methodologies and integrate automated tools or AI applications, establishing institutional best practices that elevate the performance marketing capabilities

  • Execute Minimum Viable Product Experiments: Launch fast, agile experiments to validate core hypotheses without demanding flawless internal processes initially, moving rapidly to define the long-term operational vision once lead volume and scalability are proven.

  • Drive Fast-Paced Execution: Maintain an exceptional bias for action to push initiatives forward today rather than tomorrow, breaking through resource bottlenecks by independently sourcing freelance talent or leveraging AI tools when internal capacity is stretched.

  • Lead Channel Lifecycle & Strategic Handover: Drive the end-to-end strategy for scaling promising initiatives from ad view to conversion. Define the future-state operational infrastructure, build training documentation, and seamlessly onboard team members to manage mature channels

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Foster strong collaboration with key stakeholders, both within Oviva’s marketing team to share insights and best practices, and with external teams and stakeholders, driving and contributing to cross-functional projects.

Employment type: Fixed-term contract

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company committed to ensuring that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of AI capabilities while prioritising safety, responsible use, and human needs. Our mission requires a team that represents a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences.

About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programmes that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Developer Marketing and Relations, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Creative, Media, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

About the Role

We are hiring an FTC B2B Influencer Marketing Lead, EMEA to build and scale OpenAI’s influencer marketing capability across knowledge workers (KW), business decision-makers (BDMs), and developer audiences.

You will own the strategy and hands-on delivery across multiple European markets (working closely with in-market comms & marketing team), with the UK, France, and Germany as the first priorities. You will develop local creator networks, translate regional and global priorities into market-relevant programmes, and build a portfolio that balances sustained creator relationships with high-impact moments around products, campaigns, and events.

This is a zero-to-one builder role as much as an ecosystem and operating-model role. You will create the capability from the ground up: building on the early foundations we have in place, you will be responsible for defining the strategy, securing internal alignment, building the creator and agency network, establishing the operating model, and proving what works before scaling it. You will work with existing agencies, identify and onboard new specialist partners where we have capability or market gaps, partner with PHD to amplify the strongest influencer content, and create the goals, processes, reporting, and success measures needed to run the programme with speed, quality, and accountability. You will partner closely with the B2C influencer lead to define and evolve the measurement framework.

In this role, you will

  • Own the EMEA B2B influencer marketing strategy across KW, BDM, and developer audiences, setting clear audience, market, channel, investment, and outcome priorities.

  • Build a credible bench of developer creators, technical educators, open-source voices, AI builders, and community leaders across Europe, and design programmes that genuinely help developers learn, evaluate, and build.

  • Develop differentiated creator plans for the UK, France, and Germany, balancing regional consistency with local language, culture, platform behaviour, regulation, and audience expectations.

  • Source, evaluate, and build durable relationships with creators who have genuine authority with our priority audiences. Own outreach, briefing, negotiation, contracting, content development, activation, and relationship management.

  • Design curated creator programmes and high-value experiences that deepen relationships over time—such as briefings, product access, learning sessions, roundtables, community moments, and co-created formats—turning the strongest creators into long-term strategic partners rather than one-off campaign participants.
